item.title: [Malayalam] [OTT Release] The Third Murder
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageMalayalam
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date13 Nov 2026 (OTT)

A psychological thriller that revolves around a series of mysterious and intricate serial murders. The local police force finds themselves grappling with a cunning antagonist who leaves behind riddles, pushing the investigation team to their mental and emotional limits. The film explores the dark aspects of the human psyche as the officers race against time to decipher the puzzle and prevent more killings.
